I made the code changes, but I couldn't deploy them. The tools I have here include no shell and no deploy tool, and the sf-context server is read-only against the org. Nothing has been compiled or run, either, so the tests haven't been executed.

**Changes** (in `force-app/main/default/classes/`)
- **`AccountService.cls`**: I added `validateAnnualRevenue(List<Account>)`. It calls `addError('Annual Revenue cannot be negative.')` on `AnnualRevenue` for any value below 0. Null and zero values still save.
- **`AccountTriggerHandler.cls`**: `beforeInsert` and `beforeUpdate` now call the new method, placed before the duplicate-phone check and behind the existing `bypassTrigger` guard. The signatures haven't changed, so `AccountTrigger` and any other callers are unaffected.
- **`AccountTriggerHandler_Test.cls`**: I added `testNegativeAnnualRevenueOnInsert` and `testNegativeAnnualRevenueOnUpdate`. They cover negative, zero, null and positive values, use `Database.insert` and `Database.update` with `allOrNone=false`, and check the error text.

**Conventions I followed**
- The handler stays a thin static class that delegates to `AccountService`, as it already did.
- I kept the existing static bypass flag.
- I put the new tests in the existing `AccountTriggerHandler_Test` rather than creating a new class. That matches how this org tests the handler and service together.
- This org's Account handler doesn't extend a `TriggerHandler` base class, unlike the generic pattern the knowledge base suggests. I left that alone to avoid changing existing behavior.

**To deploy**, run this from the project root:
```
sf project deploy start --source-dir force-app/main/default/classes/AccountService.cls force-app/main/default/classes/AccountTriggerHandler.cls force-app/main/default/classes/AccountTriggerHandler_Test.cls --test-level RunSpecifiedTests --tests AccountTriggerHandler_Test --tests AccountTrigger_Test --tests AccountService_Test
```
Add `--target-org <alias>` if you haven't set a default org. If you'd rather I run it, enable a shell or deploy tool and I will.

One thing to check: any existing data or tests that insert Accounts with a negative `AnnualRevenue` will now fail. I didn't scan the org for that.
